notes: Fixes for overnight sessions and label placement, so every IB block draws and labels on 24-hour charts.
changelog: Blocks that start at the session open, with no fixed start time, now draw on overnight sessions such as CME 17:00 to 16:00. Before, they showed nothing.
Fixed IBs being placed in the wrong session on trading hours where one session ends exactly as the next begins.
IB, midline and Fibonacci labels now sit at the session end on today's chart instead of in the middle of it.
The IB now completes and draws on its last bar instead of one bar later.
